title: ATAN2 evaluates ATAN(y/x) shifted by pi, drifting by 1 ULP on 37 of 120 readings and returning #NUM! when y/x overflows
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, ATAN2(x_num, y_num) computes excel_atan(y_num / x_num) shifted by ±pi in the left half-plane (and ±pi/2 when x_num = 0, #DIV/0! at (0, 0)), rather than a correctly rounded quadrant atan2(y, x). As a result, 37 of 120 ATAN2 readings in dcj9k_math differ by 1 ULP from the correctly rounded mathematical value (for instance ATAN2(-0.152, 1.21) returns 1.6957615735034952 instead of 1.6957615735034954). When x_num != 0 and y_num / x_num overflows binary64 (e.g. ATAN2(1e-200, 1e109)), Excel returns #NUM! rather than ±pi/2.
basis: Measured across all 120 ATAN2 readings in DnaCalc dcj9k_math (Excel 16.0.20527.20088, 37 differing by 1 ULP from 100-digit Decimal atan2) and verified on 2,744/2,746 full-bank ATAN2 rows.

correct.how: pi + atan(1.21 / -0.152) computed at 100 decimal digits in Python Decimal and rounded to nearest binary64.
